### Collection.prototype.aggregate: 2.x vs 3.x Syntax

Source: https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/blob/main/etc/notes/CHANGES_3.0.0.md

The aggregate method no longer accepts variadic arguments. Pipeline stages must now be provided as an Array.

```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  {$match: {a: 1}},
  {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}},
  function (err, result) {
    ...
  }
);
```

```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  [
    {$match: {a: 1}},
    {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}}
  ],
  function (err, cursor) {
    ...
  }
);
```

--------------------------------

### Collection.prototype.aggregate: Callback Return Value Change

Source: https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/blob/main/etc/notes/CHANGES_3.0.0.md

In 3.x, the aggregate method returns a cursor when a callback is provided, unlike 2.x which returned the resulting documents directly.

```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  [
    {$match: {a: 1}},
    {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}}
  ],
  function (err, result) {
    console.log(result);
  }
);
```

```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  [
    {$match: {a: 1}},
    {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}}
  ],
  function (err, cursor) {
    cursor.toArray(function(err, result) {
      console.log(result);
    });
  }
);
```

--------------------------------

### Collection.prototype.aggregate Changes

Source: https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/blob/main/etc/notes/CHANGES_3.0.0.md

The `aggregate` method no longer accepts variadic arguments. Pipeline stages must now be provided as an array. The method now returns a cursor when a callback is provided, similar to calling `cursor.toArray()`.

```APIDOC
## Collection.prototype.aggregate

### Description
Changes in the `aggregate` method for version 3.0.0.

### 2.x Syntax (Variadic Arguments - Removed)
```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  {$match: {a: 1}},
  {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}},
  function (err, result) {
    ...
  }
);
```

### 3.x Syntax (Array of Stages)
```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  [
    {$match: {a: 1}},
    {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}}
  ],
  function (err, cursor) {
    ...
  }
);
```

### Return Value Change
Previously returned resulting documents directly. Now returns a cursor when a callback is provided.

### 2.x Syntax (Callback with Result)
```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  [
    {$match: {a: 1}},
    {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}}
  ],
  function (err, result) {
    console.log(result);
  }
);
```

### 3.x Syntax (Callback with Cursor)
```javascript
collection.prototype.aggregate(
  [
    {$match: {a: 1}},
    {$project: {b: 1, _id: 0}}
  ],
  function (err, cursor) {
    cursor.toArray(function(err, result) {
      console.log(result);
    });
  }
);
```

### New Options
Support added for `comment` in the aggregation command and a `hint` field in aggregation options.
```

--------------------------------

### Collection.insert, Collection.update, and Collection.remove Removed

Source: https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/blob/main/etc/notes/CHANGES_5.0.0.md

The legacy collection methods `insert`, `update`, and `remove` have been removed. Users should migrate to `insertOne`, `insertMany`, `updateMany`, and `deleteMany` respectively.

```APIDOC
## Collection.insert, Collection.update, and Collection.remove Removed

### Description
Three legacy operation helpers on the collection class have been removed. Users should migrate to the more specific methods.

### API Migration

| Removed API                | API to migrate to              |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `insert(document)`         | `insertOne(document)`          |
| `insert(arrayOfDocuments)` | `insertMany(arrayOfDocuments)` |
| `update(filter)`           | `updateMany(filter)`           |
| `remove(filter)`           | `deleteMany(filter)`           |

### Request Example (Migration)

```typescript
// Single document insert (legacy):
await collection.insert({ name: 'spot' });
// Migration:
await collection.insertOne({ name: 'spot' });

// Multi-document insert (legacy):
await collection.insert([{ name: 'fido' }, { name: 'luna' }]);
// Migration:
await collection.insertMany([{ name: 'fido' }, { name: 'luna' }]);
```
```

--------------------------------

### Use project for field selection in find (3.x syntax)

Source: https://github.com/mongodb/node-mongodb-native/blob/main/etc/notes/CHANGES_3.0.0.md

The `fields` parameter is no longer supported in `find` and `findOne`. Use `Cursor.prototype.project` or the `projection` option for field selection.

```javascript
const cursor = coll.find({ a: 42 }).project({ someField: 1 });
```

```javascript
const cursor = coll.find({ a: 42 }, { projection: { someField: 1 } });
```
